description:
What should I wear today? Picks from your owned cabinet (CURRENT status only) based on optional prompt/weather. Returns nothing if your cabinet is empty. Requires Pro.

See also: `ai_recommend` for discovery beyond your cabinet · `user_get_cabinet` for your full collection.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

weather.description: Optional weather context, e.g. 'hot and humid'

name: ai_wear_today
